hypothesis: The review-clean S0 file, launched bare from an isolated cold-cache sandbox, reproduces the September 24 dense LR 0.015 result within predeclared noise and produces a loadable checkpoint inside the competition budget.
single_causal_change: Submission-only review-clean refactor from 116188 to S0; intended training arithmetic is unchanged, but this is a cold replay and not a claim of an improvement.

candidate_shortlist.idea: S0 cold replay on trn21 with the bare launch command
candidate_shortlist.why_ranked: Human priority and missing submission-safety evidence; S0 has exact-byte CPU G2 and lockstep receipts but no native cold replay.

candidate_shortlist.idea: Research-v2 A0 dense control on trn22
candidate_shortlist.why_ranked: Runs in parallel on the other host and supplies the table-arm comparator.

selection_rationale: Poojith directly ordered this as tonight's first trn21 job in break-glass and moonshot mode; an accepted S0 floor protects the team while higher-upside stacks are tested.
trainium_feasibility: S0 bare launch is LNC2 x four ranks on the full Trn2 chip, seed 42 and 1800-second training budget baked into train.py; use an empty job-owned compile cache. Copy only into a new isolated run location and confirm at least 6.5 GiB free and no Neuron job immediately before launch.
cheapest_falsifier: Exact S0 SHA and bare argv CPU G2 review, fresh host SHA after scp/rsync, prepare.py check, disk/idle preflight, then first five startup boundaries and finite checkpoint.

control.box_constraint: Same trn21 host, historical LR 0.015 reference; cold-vs-historical cache effects and run noise must be stated.

candidate.expected_diff: Use existing S0 train.py bytes SHA-256 ad223cdc9aa339d820b8f66e32ad35e30d3e93437a79d263a1418f7e53e125bb; no new science edit.

success_criteria.quality: Fresh-process public20M/context1024 BPB within 0.0008 of the two-run historical mean 0.99195377346572045; otherwise record mismatch and investigate, not submission-ready.
success_criteria.throughput: Informational steps and tok/s; cold startup and complete checkpoint must remain inside the official 1800-second charging rule.
success_criteria.correctness: Exact host SHA/argv, seed 42, no crash/NaN, strict checkpoint load, no budget breach, and fresh-process public20M evaluation.

abort_conditions: Host disk free is below 6.5 GiB or another train/Neuron process is present
Copied S0 train.py SHA or bare launch differs from this proposal
The unique run destination or label already exists
Any crash, NaN, missing checkpoint, strict-load, budget, or evaluation failure
Any modification of prepare.py, evaluator, tokenizer, data or existing worktrees
Any attempt to submit automatically or call a failed/unscored run a win
